PositiveInt = NewType("PositiveInt", int)
if TYPE_CHECKING:
    positive_int = PositiveInt
else:
    def positive_int(arg: str) -> int:
        """Convert a string into a positive integer.

        This will raise an exception if the string is not a positive integer.

        Parameters
        ----------
        arg : str
            The string to convert.

        Returns
        -------
        int
            The converted positive integer.

        Raises
        ------
        BadArgument
            If the string is not a positive integer.
        """
        try:
            ret = int(arg)
        except ValueError:
            raise BadArgument(_("{arg} is not an integer.").format(arg=inline(arg)))
        if ret <= 0:
            raise BadArgument(_("{arg} is not a positive integer.").format(arg=inline(arg)))
        return ret
